solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Raving person has love for a man in broadcast message

definitions.note: the name said in radio talk to mean 'message received'

indicators.note: one letter stands in place of another, so the clue's love replaces its a

parts.note: a rager is someone in a rage, raving
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A ranting person swaps romance for a man in a radio message.
explanation.definitionFit: In radio procedure the word acknowledging receipt is also a man's name, so it is literally a man inside a broadcast message.

clue.text: Agent always intended to avoid a financial transaction favouring customer

parts.note: a rep, a sales representative, acts as an agent
ay is a poetic word for always

indicators.note: a letter keeps out of the word, so it is removed

parts.note: meant is intended

explanation.surface: A sales agent who always meant to dodge a deal benefiting the customer.
explanation.definitionFit: Money paid back to someone, a transaction in the customer's favour.

clue.text: Bad-tempered type, initially getting behind

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of the word after it

parts.note: the rump is one's behind

explanation.surface: A cranky sort, first to get left behind.
explanation.definitionFit: A grumpy, irritable person.

clue.text: Sound of Aussie beast encountered in small enclosed space

indicators.note: says the words are heard spoken, not seen written

parts.note: a roo (kangaroo) met, spoken quickly

explanation.surface: Hearing a kangaroo you bumped into inside a tiny closed-in room.
explanation.walkthrough: A ROOMETTE is a small private sleeping compartment on an American train.
explanation.definitionFit: A small private compartment on a sleeping car, a tiny enclosed space.

clue.text: Celebrity died catching wild animal, right?

indicators.note: the outer letters hold another piece inside them, as a net catches

parts.note: a celebrity is a star
a boar is a wild pig

explanation.surface: A famous person dies after capturing a wild beast, apparently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'catching' is the insertion signal; 'right?' is the nautical sense, not correctness.
explanation.definitionFit: On a ship, the right-hand side looking forward has this nautical name.

clue.text: Wrong to swallow hard bone

indicators.note: one piece takes another inside it

parts.note: a sin is a wrong
H is hard, as in pencil grades

explanation.surface: It is wrong to gulp down a tough bone.
explanation.definitionFit: The front of the leg below the knee, along the shinbone or tibia.

clue.text: Respect and acknowledge reduced allowance

indicators.note: reduced means shortened, losing its final letter

parts.note: to admit is to acknowledge
a ration is a fixed allowance

explanation.surface: Showing respect and recognising a cut in a benefit.
explanation.definitionFit: Regard and esteem for someone, a synonym of respect as a noun.

clue.text: Missile not quite right for old British soldier

indicators.note: not quite means falling just short, dropping a final letter

parts.note: a bullet is a missile
R is right

explanation.surface: A projectile almost but not quite right for a veteran British trooper.
explanation.walkthrough: General Sir Redvers Buller commanded British forces in the Boer War.
explanation.definitionFit: General Sir Redvers Buller led British troops in South Africa in the Boer War.

clue.text: What's authentic about upcoming broadcast related to insurance business

indicators.note: the outer word goes around the other piece

parts.note: something actual is real, authentic

indicators.note: in a down clue, upcoming means read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to air is to broadcast

explanation.surface: Truthful coverage of an upcoming programme about the insurance trade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upcoming' is the reversal signal in a down clue, and 'about' the containment signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An actuary calculates insurance risks, so this adjective describes that work.

clue.text: Amusing turn daughter's put on

indicators.note: in a down clue, the first piece is placed on top of the second

parts.note: D is daughter, with 's as 'is'
a roll is a turn over

explanation.surface: A funny act that the daughter performs.
explanation.definitionFit: Wryly comic or whimsically funny.

clue.text: Quiet town, one I hesitate to say that's dangerously unstable

definitions.note: an adjective phrase describing the radioactive element; with 'that's' it reads as 'something that is'

parts.note: P is piano, quiet in music
Luton is a town in Bedfordshire, north of London
the Roman numeral I is one
um is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A sleepy English town that the speaker is reluctant to call unstable.
explanation.walkthrough: LUTON is a commuter town north of London, chosen here as a generic 'town'.
explanation.definitionFit: The element is radioactive and fissile, the stuff of bombs: a hazardously unstable substance.

clue.text: Football, ultimately maybe a German game?

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word before it

parts.note: Otto is a typical German man's name, an example of a German

explanation.surface: Asking whether football is, in the end, a German sport.
explanation.definitionFit: A lottery-style numbers game of chance, played for prizes.

clue.text: Having secured facility on smartphone, you had talked freely

indicators.note: the outer letters have fastened another piece within them

parts.note: ye'd is an old contraction of 'you had'
an app is a program on a phone

explanation.surface: Someone, having installed a phone app, chatted away freely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Having secured' signals containment; 'you had' is the archaic contraction ye'd.
explanation.definitionFit: To yap is to chatter on at length, to talk without restraint.

clue.text: Drink to be knocked back in autumn? It's a sporting option

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: fall is the American word for autumn

indicators.note: knocked back reads the word backwards, as well as meaning drunk

parts.note: beer is a drink

explanation.surface: A beer to be downed in the autumn months, offered as a sporting choice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be knocked back' signals reversal and 'in' insertion. In snooker, a fouled player may be granted this and nominate any ball.
explanation.definitionFit: In snooker, after a foul leaves a player snookered, they may nominate any ball: a sporting option.

clue.text: One coming off drugs, having "a bit of a chest"

parts.note: with means having
a drawer is part of a chest of drawers

explanation.surface: A recovering addict suffering from a slight chest complaint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a bit of a chest' hints at an ailment but means a drawer from the furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: A person in withdrawal, going off a drug, is one who withdraws.

clue.text: Elaborate accommodation for king, one in exile?

indicators.note: giving accommodation to something means housing it inside

parts.note: to expatiate is to elaborate at length
R is rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: Fancy lodgings provided for a king, perhaps a monarch in exile.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Elaborate' looks like an adjective for the accommodation but is the verb EXPATIATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone living outside their native country, like an exile.

clue.text: Arrangement that does for NI patriot?

definitions.text: Arrangement that does for NI patriot?

indicators.note: an arrangement here is a reordering of letters

parts.note: NI is Northern Ireland

explanation.surface: A settlement that would spell the end for a Northern Irish nationalist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arrangement' reshuffles NI PATRIOT, and the division of Ireland is exactly what defeats an Irish nationalist's cause.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1921 division of Ireland was a political settlement that frustrated Irish nationalists.

clue.text: Mark brought by corporal punishment? Son avoids that

indicators.note: a letter stays away from the word, so it is taken out

parts.note: the stick, a cane used for beating

explanation.surface: A mark left by a beating, which a son manages to dodge.
explanation.definitionFit: A small check mark showing something is correct or done.

clue.text: A smirk so naughty when receiving good present with a hug?

indicators.note: the scrambled letters take another piece inside them
naughty means misbehaving, so the letters are disordered

parts.note: G is good

explanation.surface: A cheeky grin from someone getting a nice present with a cuddle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'naughty' rearranges A SMIRK SO, and 'when receiving' takes G inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A greeting delivered in person with a kiss, a novelty gift with a hug.

clue.text: Girl's hair the result of a bad hair day?

definitions.text: the result of a bad hair day?

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, with possessive 's
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: A girl's hairdo explained as the fallout of a bad hair day.
explanation.definitionFit: Anxiety or upset, which is what a bad hair day causes.

clue.text: Hesitation to get into meditation when lectures should be attended?

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: TM is transcendental meditation
er is the sound of hesitating

explanation.surface: A pause before meditating, at the time lectures ought to be attended.
explanation.definitionFit: A university's academic period of teaching, when students should be at lectures.

clue.text: One of two books, very serious, written by the French

parts.note: chronic in British slang means very bad or severe
les is French for 'the' in the plural

explanation.surface: One of a pair of weighty volumes, penned by the French.
explanation.walkthrough: The Old Testament has two books of this name, First and Second.
explanation.definitionFit: The Old Testament contains two books with this title, 1 and 2.

clue.text: Piano learner has found out about organ

indicators.note: the outer word goes around the other pieces

parts.note: seen means spotted, found out
P is piano in music
L is learner, as on L-plates

explanation.surface: A piano pupil has discovered something about the organ.
explanation.definitionFit: An organ of the body near the stomach that filters blood.

clue.text: Loud murderer with yen for ostentation

parts.note: F is forte, loud in music
a ripper, as in Jack the Ripper, is a killer
Y is the symbol for the Japanese yen

explanation.surface: A noisy killer with a fondness for showing off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'yen' reads as a craving but is the currency.
explanation.definitionFit: Showy, needless ornament or display, a synonym for ostentation.

clue.text: Swing that sees weak Right being ousted by Left

indicators.note: one letter is driven out and another takes its place

parts.note: frail is weak
R is right
L is left

explanation.surface: A political swing where a feeble Right loses out to the Left.
explanation.definitionFit: To flail is to swing the arms wildly.

clue.text: Coat officer gashes when falling over

indicators.note: falling over turns the letters upside down, read backwards

parts.note: OC is officer commanding
gashes are cuts

explanation.surface: A commander tears his coat when he falls over.
explanation.definitionFit: A plaster coating applied to walls, a kind of coat.

clue.text: Tree making church gloomy, almost

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: almost means one letter short at the end

parts.note: dark is gloomy

explanation.surface: A tree that casts a gloom over the church.
explanation.definitionFit: A coniferous evergreen, a kind of tree.

clue.text: Joint in handle, one coming loose

indicators.note: a letter coming loose drops out of the word

parts.note: to wield is to handle
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A joint in a handle where something has come loose.
explanation.definitionFit: A seam where metal pieces have been fused together.

clue.text: Female shows spite rejecting male

definitions.note: a girl's name standing for a female

indicators.note: the word throws out a letter

parts.note: malice is spite

explanation.surface: A woman shows spite by spurning a man.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's name, so an example of a female, as in Lewis Carroll's heroine.

clue.text: Little fellow, the German who takes a quick break?

definitions.note: a relative clause standing for the person who does it

parts.note: wee is Scots for little
Ken is a man's name
der is German for 'the'

explanation.surface: A small German man who nips off for a short holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who goes away for a short Saturday-to-Sunday trip.

clue.text: Lake in garden transformed foreign city once

parts.note: L is the map abbreviation for lake

indicators.note: transformed means the letters are changed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A pond in a garden transformed by landscaping, in a city abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint Petersburg in Russia bore this Soviet name from 1924 to 1991.

clue.text: See, previously, army of abstainers taking alcohol

parts.note: the SA, Salvation Army, whose members shun drink
rum is an alcoholic drink

explanation.surface: Teetotal soldiers taking a drink, an old-fashioned sight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' is a bishop's diocese, not the verb; Old Sarum was the original site of Salisbury, a cathedral city in Wiltshire.
explanation.definitionFit: This was the old name of the Salisbury diocese, an earlier bishop's see.
